content.text:
Image 1: Eight-panel storyboard reference, used for the overall shot structure, shot sizes, and camera-movement rhythm. Read it from left to right and from top to bottom; panel N is Shot N.
Image 2: Live-action reference of The Quinn family mansion, living room, used as the benchmark for environmental composition, lighting, and realistic live-action texture; it contains no people.
Image 3: Subject 1 (Cassie) character appearance reference.
Image 4: Subject 2 (Natalie) character appearance reference.
Image 5: Subject 3 (Lauren) character appearance reference.
[Subject settings]
Subject 1 (Cassie): Refer to Image 3. 23, Lauren's daughter and Natalie's spoiled stepsister, who schemes to send Natalie into the marriage meant for her. Outfit: A pale-pink silk slip dress with thin straps, falling to mid-thigh, under a cropped white tweed-texture long-sleeve jacket worn open. Pink strappy heeled sandals. All plain, with no logos. Signature colour: pink.
Subject 2 (Natalie): Refer to Image 4. 25, George's daughter from his first marriage, struggling to pay for her sick mother's dialysis; the drama's heroine. Outfit: A worn light-blue knit cardigan, open, over a plain white crew-neck short-sleeve cotton T-shirt. Faded mid-blue straight-leg jeans and plain white canvas sneakers. She carries a simple brown canvas shoulder bag. Everything is plain, with no logos or prints. Signature colour: blue.
Subject 3 (Lauren): Refer to Image 5. 50, George's second wife and Natalie's stepmother, Cassie's mother; the controlling matriarch of the Quinn mansion. Outfit: A fitted crimson-red long-sleeve knee-length sheath dress with a round neckline, a thin gold belt at the waist, nude pointed-toe high heels and a pearl necklace. All plain, with no logos. Signature colour: red.
Environment (The Quinn family mansion, living room): Refer to Image 2. Day, soft natural daylight from the tall windows. Soft natural daylight comes through the sheer curtains of the windows on the left wall at frame left. The chandelier is unlit and faint warm wall sconces glow. Live sound is quiet room tone and fabric rustling.
Do not swap the characters' appearances, clothing, actions, positions or dialogue.
[Overall style]
Photorealistic live-action short drama with cinematic lighting. Each character keeps the face and the outfit with its main colour from their reference image throughout. Use each character sheet only for that character: the face from the close-up on the right, the body and outfit from the turnaround on the left; do not render the sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. This segment has 8 lines, in this order: Cassie, Lauren, Natalie, Natalie, Cassie, Cassie, Cassie, Lauren. Generate speech only from the lines in {} in the shot list, each spoken exactly once by its speaker; everyone else keeps their mouth naturally closed while listening, and a V.O. speaker keeps their mouth closed or is off screen. Follow the shot list below; do not add cuts or camera moves beyond it. Strictly adhere to the 180-degree rule: within a scene, characters keep their screen sides and the camera stays on one side of the axis. Seamless continuity of action, spatial matching and consistent actor blocking; cut on action. For dialogue prefer static shot-reverse-shot and over-the-shoulder shots, balanced with reaction shots and close-up inserts. Faces stable and clear, consistent with the reference images, with no resemblance to any real actor or actress. Normal human eyes. Natural anatomy and hands. Natural, fluid motion that follows the blocking; characters make subtle, natural movements. Characters, props and environment share one world with matched lighting. Each line ends naturally with breathing room and is never cut off. Authentic performances with micro-expressions. No BGM; generate only dialogue, environmental sounds and action sounds. No subtitles.
[Strictly exclude]
Natalie smiling. George in frame or an empty sofa or empty sofa seat in frame. hands clapping, clasping, gripping or overlapping each other or an object in frame. readable text on the hospital statement. subtitles or captions. Dialogue from the wrong character, multiple people speaking at once, repeated or missing lines, lip-sync errors and audio-visual desynchronization. The raw reference images (character sheets, setting plates) appearing as a frame of the video, and starting on a still frame of the setting reference. A fast zoom-in at the start, a fast pull-back at the end, unmotivated whip-pans, tilts, zooms and 360-degree orbits. Axis-crossing, jump cuts, frame skips, flicker and clipping. Characters or props popping in or vanishing, and duplicate characters except mirror reflections. Readable text, numbers, logos and watermarks; phones and paper are shown from the back or out of focus. Black-and-white, monochrome, grayscale, desaturated visuals; hand-drawn, sketch, line art, illustration, comics, animation; storyboard frames, rough sketches, panel borders, gutters and grid layouts.
[Shot list] (8 shots, approximately 18 seconds)
When a previous-shot reference image is given, Shot 1 matches its camera position, shot size and blocking and continues from that moment; do not repeat that frame later.
At the start: The camera stays on the near side of the coffee table, facing the back wall, windows at frame left. Natalie stands just inside the right-wall doorway at frame right, beside the empty front-right armchair, turned back toward the room. She holds the flat hospital statement at her side, her bag hangs from her shoulder, and her eyes are glassy without tears. Cassie stands at the right side of the empty front-left armchair, on the coffee-table side, facing Natalie toward frame right, arms relaxed at her sides. Lauren sits forward on the sofa's right end, turned toward Cassie, hands still in her lap. George sits on the sofa's left end; every shot is framed to exclude the sofa's left end, so he stays out of frame.
Shot 1 (0-3s): [Medium shot, two-shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side, facing the right wall. Behind both of them are the pale grey right wall and the open doorway; the back wall with the sofa lies entirely beyond frame left. Cassie is on frame left by the front-left armchair and Natalie on frame right by the right-wall doorway.] Cassie takes a slow half step toward Natalie and tilts her head with a sweet, poisonous smile, her hands at her sides. Natalie faces her with a wary frown, no smile. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sing-song, triumphant): {If you marry Sebastian Klein in my place.}
Shot 2 (3-6s): [Medium shot, low angle from the near side facing the back wall on Lauren at the sofa's right end, slight push in, framed on her chest and face. Behind her are the upper back wall, the edge of the framed painting and the potted fig at the right of the arch. The sofa's left end lies beyond frame left and the right-wall doorway beyond frame right.] Lauren sits up straighter and beams proudly toward Cassie, her hands resting still in her lap. Dialogue (Lauren, in English, delighted, haughty): {My daughter is so smart. That's a good idea.}
Shot 3 (6-9s): [Close-up, eye-level, locked-off from the near side facing the right wall on Natalie's face as she faces frame left toward Cassie. Behind her is only the pale grey right wall beside the doorway frame.] Natalie's eyes widen in disbelief and she draws her head back, her lips parted in shock, no smile. Her hands and the statement stay below frame. Dialogue (Natalie, in English, stunned): {Sebastian Klein? The illegitimate son of the Klein family?}
Shot 4 (9-11s): [Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from the near side behind Cassie's right shoulder onto Natalie at the right-wall doorway, handheld, facing the right wall. Behind Natalie are the pale grey right wall and the open doorway frame; the back wall with the sofa lies beyond frame left.] Natalie shakes her head slightly and frowns at Cassie, no smile. Cassie's shoulder and curls fill the foreground. Dialogue (Natalie, in English, incredulous): {Isn't he in jail right now?}
Shot 5 (11-12s): [Medium close-up, eye-level, locked-off from the near side by the front-right armchair on Cassie beside the front-left armchair. The camera faces the left wall, so behind her the sheer-curtained windows fill the background and the sofa lies beyond frame right.] Cassie shrugs one shoulder and pops her glossy lips. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, breezy): {Yup.}
Shot 6 (12-15s): [Medium shot, low angle on Cassie beside the coffee table, slow orbit on the near side from her front to her right side while the camera keeps facing the left-wall windows. Behind her are the sheer-curtained windows, the upper wall and the unlit chandelier; the sofa stays beyond frame right and below frame.] Cassie wrinkles her nose in disgust and tosses her head so her platinum curls swing over her shoulder, her hands at her sides. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, mocking lilt): {He's a dirt bag and a good for nothing loser.}
Shot 7 (15-17s): [Medium shot, eye-level, locked-off from the near side facing the right wall on Natalie standing by the doorway. Behind her are only the pale grey right wall and the doorway frame; Cassie and the sofa lie beyond frame left.] Natalie recoils a half step with wide eyes, shakes her head and presses her lips tight in refusal, no smile. Her hands and the flat statement hang at her side below frame. Cassie is off screen. Dialogue (Cassie, in English, spoiled, matter-of-fact): {That's why I can't marry him.}
Shot 8 (17-18s): [Medium close-up, eye-level, quick cut from the near side facing the back wall to Lauren at the sofa's right end, framed on her face and shoulders. Behind her are the sofa back and the potted fig at the right of the arch. The sofa's left end lies beyond frame left and the right-wall doorway beyond frame right.] Lauren nods firmly with a thin red smile, her hands still in her lap. Dialogue (Lauren, in English, crisp): {That's right.}
At the end: The camera stays on the near side of the coffee table, facing the back wall, windows at frame left. Natalie stands just inside the right-wall doorway at frame right, beside the empty front-right armchair, facing the sofa with pressed lips and no smile. Her eyes are glassy without tears, the flat hospital statement is at her side and her bag hangs from her shoulder. Cassie stands at the right side of the empty front-left armchair, on the coffee-table side, arms relaxed at her sides. Lauren sits on the sofa's right end, nodding, hands still in her lap. George sits on the sofa's left end, out of frame.
